name: database
description: Lakebase Postgres pool + schema declaration via defineSchema. CRUD/OBO/RLS surface ships incrementally in subsequent stack layers; this layer provides the pool, schema convention loader, and column metadata.

required.description: Lakebase Postgres instance for application data. Schema lives at config/database/schema.ts.

branch.description: Full Lakebase Postgres branch resource name.

database.description: Full Lakebase Postgres database resource name.

databaseName.description: Postgres database name for local development.

connection.description: Optional pg.Pool overrides forwarded to createLakebasePool. Avoid setting `password`/`user` here — Lakebase uses OAuth.

statementTimeoutMs.description: Server-side `statement_timeout` (ms) applied per pool connection. Defaults to 15_000.

tolerateSetupFailure.description: If true, plugin boot continues with an empty schema when config/database/schema.ts fails to load. Off by default.

oboPoolMax.description: Max number of distinct OBO pools held in the LRU. Worst-case fan-out is oboPoolMax × OBO_POOL_DEFAULTS.max + POOL_DEFAULTS.max connections per app instance.

onSetupMessage: Database plugin installed. Configure your schema in config/database/schema.ts via defineSchema(). The plugin currently exposes pool access (appkit.database.getPool()); CRUD, OBO, and RLS surfaces ship in subsequent stack layers.
